units.text: As a disabled Veteran, you may be eligible for the VR&E Independent Living track if you have a service-connected disability that limits your daily activities (like bathing, dressing, getting around, or interacting with others) and you can't return to work right away.
supporting_chunk_ids: VR&E Independent Living Track | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The context states eligibility if service-connected disability limits daily activities and prevents immediate return to work.

units.text: You may also get these services while working toward a job goal with your Vocational Rehabilitation Counselor (VRC).
supporting_chunk_ids: VR&E Independent Living Track | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The context says services can be received while working toward a job goal with VRC.

units.text: Services can include assessments, counseling, referrals, and help with home modifications through the Adaptive Housing program.
supporting_chunk_ids: VR&E Independent Living Track | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The context lists assessments, counseling, referrals, and guidance on Adaptive Housing program for home modifications.

units.text: These services usually last up to 24 months, but may be extended in some cases.
supporting_chunk_ids: VR&E Independent Living Track | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The context states services typically last up to 24 months, with possible extensions.

units.text: To apply, you need to apply for VR&E benefits through eBenefits, then work with a VRC to develop an independent living plan.
supporting_chunk_ids: VR&E Independent Living Track | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The context instructs to apply for VR&E benefits via eBenefits and then work with VRC to develop an independent living plan.

units.text: For more details, see the VR&E Independent Living track page.
supporting_chunk_ids: VR&E Independent Living Track | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The context is from the VR&E Independent Living track page, so this is supported.
